**AltaVista** was a former web search engine, and the **altavista.com** domain is now defunct/redirected rather than an active standalone AltaVista service.[1]

If you meant the site itself, AltaVista was launched in **December 1995**, was based in **Palo Alto, California**, and was later acquired by **Yahoo**; by **June 2013** the domain had been redirected to Yahoo Search.[1]

If you meant a current website, **altavista.com** no longer serves the original AltaVista search engine.[1]
